answer: Locks are written down in atlas, expire in ledge, and yarrow lists each expiry. An attacker running 127 aliases hence needs 124 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4532 identities would post 1227 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
